data.title: 玛奇玛 · 居家晚餐
data.description: 【玛奇玛 · 居家晚餐】温馨整洁的高级公寓餐厅里，餐桌上摆满了精致可口的家常料理。玛奇玛解下围裙坐在对面，单手托腮微笑着为你斟满红酒——「忙碌了一整天辛苦了。尝尝看我的手艺吧……如果全部吃完的话，待会儿或许会有意想不到的特别奖励哦。」
data.action: 坐在餐桌旁，一手托腮，另一手为对面斟红酒
data.promptProse: At her apartment dinner table, Makima rests her chin in one palm while pouring red wine into the opposite crystal glass with her other hand, regarding her unseen guest softly. Relaxed casual clothes retain the off-duty scene. The medium view keeps bottle, glass and place settings distinct against the quiet room. Warm pendant light shines through the wine and catches the bottle shoulder, leaving rounded glass shadows across the evening tabletop.
